Direct exact checks encompass all 18,248 labeled trees up to seven vertices (1,119,262 vertices) and an eight-vertex joint distribution. Finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The all-vertex radial shell multiset is a natural Euclidean invariant for canonical tree zonotopes. A complete degree-sequence product provides every shell multiplicity for infinitely many nonisometric realizations and is explained by unexpected mutual local independence. Exact inner/outer contact classes, sharp variance extremizers and opposing Gaussian versus chi-square asymptotic distributions are substantive consequences and distinguish the statistic from established directional widths and intrinsic volumes.
